"""Emitted segment-tier host: one function repeating a control-flow run."""


def emit_seg_host(base: int) -> int:
    acc = base + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values = [acc]
    values.append(acc + 2)
    total = sum(values)
    while total > 100:
        total = total - 10
    label = str(total)
    base = len(label)
    acc = base + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values = [acc]
    values.append(acc + 2)
    total = sum(values)
    while total > 100:
        total = total - 10
    label = str(total)
    base = len(label)
    return base
